description:
List and sell your own game from its GitHub repo; no wallet needed to
    start. what: 'plan' (`answers` → design doc, plan and elo.json; none: the
    questions), 'check' (repo: the launch checklist), 'draft' (repo +
    `changes`, e.g. {"price": "4.99", "wallet": "0x…", "multiplayer": "match",
    "accept_terms": true}: your elo.json with them made, and its checklist;
    `manifest` edits your local copy instead of GitHub's), 'list' (repo),
    'pull' (slug: read the repo again after a commit), 'sale' (slug: where the
    sale we set up stands), 'price' (slug, usd_cents, rails: setPrices calldata
    for a ticket your wallet owns), 'coin' (optional; `changes` e.g. {"recipe":
    "loop", "name": "…", "symbol": "…", "wallet": "0x…"}: your coin and its fee
    loop, previewed, and the one transaction your wallet sends; none: the
    recipes; changes.game names the game, whose economy must be open for the
    transaction), 'loops' (wallet: the coins it made, each with the coin block for
    elo.json), 'economy' (slug: paper or your coin, the currency, and the
    threshold that opens your coin — any one of wishlists, players, copies or
    recommending reviews; with wallet and changes {currency: {name, symbol},
    mode: "paper" | "real", coin, payer}: set them. Your servers grant and spend
    at /api/economy/<slug>/grant and /spend, signed with a server key; the same
    calls answer on paper or as the coin transfer your payer sends),
    'wishlists' (slug: how many signed-in people wishlisted it, and the
    purchases and activations off it, by day), 'web' (we host your browser
    build, free within the caps: no slug, how and the caps; slug, what is wanted and live and the last check's
    report. To publish, zip the build with its page at the top, attach it to
    a GitHub release, and draft changes {"web": {"url": <the asset link>,
    "sha256": <its sha256>}}), 'build' (slug: build what elo.json's web block
    wants now, once a minute), 'credits' (what credits pay for, the packs and
    Claude's prices; you buy and spend them signed in on elopros.com). With a
    listed game's developer wallet: 'spec' (what size to
    draw each picture, where it shows, the file limits), 'desk' (wallet: the
    games it may edit), 'files' (slug, wallet, changes {"sha256": [...]}: one
    signature for a set of pictures and trailers, and the curl line that
    sends each), 'page' (slug, wallet, changes: the store page's fields —
    name, blurb, about, tags, capsule, square, icon, hero, media), 'stats'
    (slug, wallet, changes {stats, achievements, boards}) and 'servers' (slug,
    wallet, changes {servers: [...]}, a community game's list) and 'ballot'
    (slug, wallet, changes {key, title, question, topic, options, opens_at,
    closes_at, coin}: a game question for your coin's holders; votes(game=slug)
    reads it back). 'clip': give your players videos of their play (the
    clip SDK, made in their browser). Each signed
    step: call without a signature for sign_this and index, sign it with your
    wallet, call again with index and signature. You commit and you send; we
    store nothing and sign nothing.
name: dev
